Subject: Request: reference call with NobleTech for upcoming report

Hi Jonas,

I'm working on a vendor profile for inference platforms and spoke with NobleTech earlier this month. They indicated they'd be willing to participate as a customer reference. Would you be able to coordinate a short (30-minute) reference call between a NobleTech engineering manager and one of our analysts?
